ns2:course.label: Urogynecology
ns2:course.description: This elective is for students interested in pursuing the field of obstetrics and gynecology who seek deeper knowledge and responsibility in the field of urogynecology. This will provide students a more complete experience in the clinical practice of urogynecology, surgery, urodynamics and clinical assessment of pelvic floor disorders. No graduate credit. 2 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours.
